name: DEAD END ACADEMY
source:
WELCOME TO DEAD END ACADEMY!

An all-girls school with crazy menhera chicks roaming around instead of gay catholic ones like C*i-chan!? A grading system where failing = passing!? An honor student who's never stepped foot inside of the school!?! What a doozy! 

And ironically, enough...our coveted honor student thinks so too! 

(As if you're not a strange case yourself...Ms. Little Goody Wolf...)

Well, today, she's stepping in and showing us who's...NOT BOSS!? THIS CHICK'S A WUSS!

I've got a headache....

(PS; Happy birthday to our headmaster DEATHICUTE!)

(It's not actually her birthday www)

[From [url=https://shinitai-tan.itch.io/dead-end-academy]itch.io[/url]]
